cesm-atm.title: CESM-ATM
cesm-atm.description: Climate simulation (Community Earth System Model, atmosphere component). 79 2D fields of 1800x3600, plus one 3D field of 26x1800x3600; single precision. The 'cleared' variant zeroes all background data.

exaalt.title: EXAALT
exaalt.description: Molecular dynamics simulation. Particle fields (x, y, z, vx, vy, vz) stored separately; single precision, little-endian.

qmcpack.title: QMCPACK
qmcpack.description: Many-body ab initio Quantum Monte Carlo (electronic structure of atoms, molecules and solids). 1 field, 288 orbitals of 115x69x69, single precision, little-endian.
qmcpack.source: QMCPACK performance test; contact Ye Luo (yeluo@anl.gov)

xgc.title: XGC
xgc.description: Fusion simulation (XGC gyrokinetic code). 9 time steps on an unstructured mesh (20694 nodes x 512), double precision, little-endian; the mesh is included in the archive.
